matomaki_radziwill_tao_2015.citation: Matomaki, Radziwill, & Tao (2015), 'An averaged form of Chowla's conjecture', Algebra & Number Theory 9(9), 2167-2196 (arXiv:1503.05121)
matomaki_radziwill_tao_2015.proved_statement: sum_{h_1,...,h_k <= H} |sum_{n <= X} lambda(n+h_1)...lambda(n+h_k)| = o(H^k X) as H(X) -> infty (rate O((log log H / log H) H^k X))
exact_transfer_barriers: Averages over additive shifts n + h rather than the multiplicative ratio kernel Hcal_Y(m, n) on [1, 2T]^2.

Short-interval L^2 comparison controls almost-all intervals [x, x+H] relative to the long average on [X, 2X]; it neither eliminates exceptional scales Y nor improves deterministic single-window summatory bounds beyond the classical zero-free region.

tao_2016_logarithmic_chowla.citation: Tao (2016), 'The logarithmically averaged Chowla and Elliott conjectures for two-point correlations', Forum of Mathematics, Pi 4, e8 (arXiv:1509.05422)
tao_2016_logarithmic_chowla.proved_statement: sum_{x/omega(x) < n <= x} lambda(a_1*n + b_1)*lambda(a_2*n + b_2)/n = o(log omega(x)) as omega(x) -> infty when a_1*b_2 - a_2*b_1 != 0
exact_transfer_barriers: Requires non-zero additive determinant a_1*b_2 - a_2*b_1 != 0 along a 1D shift correlation, whereas sum_{m,n} lambda(m)*lambda(n)*Hcal_Y(m, n) is a 2D separable-plus-subtracted-diagonal form.

Requires logarithmic scale averaging over a growing multiplicative span omega(x) -> infty, whereas TC061R-OBL-SIGNED-REMAINDER-F requires deterministic control on every fixed-ratio dyadic window [Y, tau*Y] (constant span tau).

Entropy decrement across prime-dilation scales yields iterated-logarithmic decay rather than a positive power-of-logarithm saving (log Y)^{-kappa_eta} (kappa_eta > 0) required to absorb (log Y)^2 * Theta_eps^{diag}(Y).
